risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has implemented a cybersecurity risk management program led by an experienced SVP-IT (25+ years) and has established a dedicated security committee reporting to the CFO and Chief Legal Officer. The Board monitors these risks through the audit committee. Governance is well-structured but the company remains exposed to typical industry threats.

risks.title: Real Estate Debt
risks.score_rationale: The company carries substantial debt in mortgage loans totaling approximately 5.1 billion USD. With variable rates and staggered maturities, the company is exposed to interest rate increase risk. This debt is characteristic of the REIT business model but represents significant financial leverage.

risks.title: Inflation and Operating Cost Increases
risks.score_rationale: Inflation negatively impacted costs in 2025 and is expected to continue affecting operating costs in 2026. While most leases contain CPI-based rent adjustments and shift certain costs to tenants, the company bears a significant portion of cost control responsibility.

risks.title: Vacancy and Occupancy Risks
risks.score_rationale: As an operator of shopping centers, the company is exposed to commercial space vacancy risks, competition, and shifts in consumer behavior. The ability to re-lease vacant spaces at market rents directly impacts performance.

risks.title: Real Estate Asset Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company regularly evaluates impairment potential of its properties by analyzing expected operating cash flows, market trends, and capitalization rates. Significant changes in market conditions or cash flows could result in material impairment losses.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to standard regulations regarding data protection, financial security, and governance. Language used in the report indicates appropriate management but risk remains low to moderate.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Management of complex real estate lease contracts potentially exposes the company to litigation risk, but no material litigation is mentioned in the provided 10-K extracts.

ai_positioning.summary: The company MAC shows no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided 10-K extracts. As a traditional REIT focused on shopping center operations and management, the company does not emphasize AI or automation technologies in its disclosed operations.
